question_text: July Exam Memo 2009 Grade 11 History Question 1-Source Based Analysis Question-The Arms race Each side anxious to show the other side up and to be the guilty party (propaganda), both sides keen to find out what the other side was up to (intelligence). 2x2=(4) Human spies and technological equipment. (2) Nuclear deterrent=nuclear capability prevents countries from going to war because of its destructive power. PLEASE DON’T COUNT OUT THE WORDS, JUST DON’T WRITE TOO MUCH! (3) By this stage the USSR also has the atom bomb, he is aware that this makes for “an uneasy peace”, but he is more than likely referring to the Truman Doctrine and the Marshall Plan to be used to contain Russia, using aid and the threat of weapons should allow for America to keep the USSR at bay. (6) MY MISTAKE IN ASKING YOU TO DECIDE WHICH IS WHICH-YOU JUST HAD TO EXPLAIN THE MESSAGE OF EACH CARTOON-APOLOGIES! They are both Soviet cartoons-Source C is a strong Soviet perception that the USA, shown by the dollar signs on the guard’s shoulders, is surprised that the USSR has developed the atom bomb. The US “atomic monopoly” has been burst and the USA and the USSR is now on an equal footing. Source D takes a very anti-Western stance, puts Nazi Germany and Western capitalism in the same coach. NATO, SEATO and CENTO were all set up to deal with a perceived Soviet threat; according to this cartoonist it is the West that is fuelling the arms race. He believes that the West is very hostile and provocative, but the West is quick to blame the USSR for the tension. subject: biology
question_stem_text: A mycorrhiza is a mutualistic relationship between fungal hyphae and the roots of true plants. The hyphae increase the absorptive surface of the plant’s roots by aiding in the absorption of water, phosphorus and other mineral ions from the soil to the roots of plants. The plant is photosynthetic and provides the fungus with carbohydrates. Scientists conducted an experiment to determine the effect of mycorrhizal associations on plant growth. The experiment was conducted as follow: • Two groups of plants were grown. • One group was planted in soil that had been sterilised (free from living microorganisms). • The other group was planted in the same type of soil but the soil had not been sterilised. • All other factors remained the same between the two groups. • The plants were allowed to grow for 8 week. • Each week, the height (in centimeters) of each plant was measured. The table below shows the growth of the plants over the 8-week period. question_text: What do Othello's lines (1-22) reveal about his change in character in the play? Provide an example from earlier in the play to support your answer.
memo_answer: Othello was a confident general in the beginning of the play. He loved his wife and was confident that she loved him back.
